about: Version 3: the screensaver and the lock screen apart, the lock on the wallpaper after the calendar. Screensaver: tools/showcase/screensaver-video.sh NPV_SPOTIFY=1 take, the user's Spotify playing "Hey Ladies" (Beastie Boys, Paul's Boutique).

clips.name: home-to-widget
clips.where: a hard cut from the title on the same home-screen frame; the camera pushes in onto the cursor; the clock set down beside Weather; ends once it has settled

clips.name: quick-settings
clips.where: top right: the panel grows from its icon, the Wi-Fi submenu

clips.name: desktop-widget
clips.where: middle: right-click the wallpaper, Add Widget, a clock drops in

clips.name: menu-slide
clips.where: top: the calendar, sliding across the status menus

clips.name: lock
clips.where: the lock screen on the same wallpaper (user, 2026-10-22); the prompt, the password, unlocked

clips.name: files-drag
clips.where: middle: only the drag of the Files window, a pause once it is set down, the camera pulling back

clips.name: app-grid
clips.where: whole screen: the grid opens over the desktop, the cursor goes into Utilities, the folder opens and closes (user, 2026-10-22: the folder came out of nowhere)

clips.name: dock-menu
clips.where: bottom: an app in the dock, its name label, its menu

clips.name: settings-drag
clips.where: middle: Settings dragged, then closed (its window shrinks away) as the camera pulls back

clips.name: search
clips.where: whole screen: the overview opens, the cursor goes up and clicks the search bar, types, the results pop up, and it all closes back to the home screen, which the lock slides down over

clips.name: screensaver-enter
clips.where: whole screen: Now Playing opens over the desktop through a blur; a drop of glass falls and forms the cover

clips.name: screensaver-tilt
clips.where: the cover, the camera still on it (user, 2026-10-22): the cursor tilts it, its rim glints

clips.name: screensaver-next
clips.where: whole screen: the lyrics, then Next: the next song on Paul's Boutique

clips.name: home
clips.where: back to the desktop through a blur
